narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now.** `exit=0`, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bump. `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new shape is `retryCount`. It threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`.

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flags. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`.

Fixed in [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) and [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 remaining warnings are all deprecations. Real, but not build breakers.

Next: clean up `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js`. It goes away in v5.
